name: rimworld
title: RimWorld
reminders: RimWorld: check the item shows its Mod and game-version tags (such as 1.7); players and mod managers filter by them. The Steam client route sets them; SteamCMD cannot.
facts: A mod's About/About.xml names it in <name> and gives its version in <modVersion> (a field RimWorld added in 1.4); <supportedVersions> lists the game versions as <li> entries.

The game's own uploader writes the item's number into About/PublishedFileId.txt beside About.xml, as decimal text. A folder with that file is the same Workshop item, so the catalogue and the file must agree.
RimWorld's own uploader tags an item Mod and with each supported version. Source: a Ludeon forum report (https://ludeon.com/forums/index.php?msg=337218); not checked against Valve's documentation.
